entities.summary: Sonali Deraniyagala (b. 1964, Colombo) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Colombo and Sri Lanka. Known in the fields of sri lanka, merchants & economists, asia.
